seo.title: Nguyen & Kim | Wedding Invitation
seo.description: Save the date for Nguyen and Kim on December 19th, 2026 at JW Marriott Hotel & Suites Saigon.
seo.ogDescription: Join Nguyen and Kim in celebrating their wedding day on December 19th, 2026.

countdown.title: COUNTDOWN
countdown.copyLine1: In the heart of Saigon, a day of love and celebration awaits.
countdown.copyLine2: A moment to slow down, to be present, and to share in the beginning of our forever.

calendar.title: Wedding calendar
calendar.copyLine1: With every passing day, we're one step closer to the moment we've been waiting for.
calendar.copyLine2: Save the date, and come share in a day filled with love and memories to keep.
calendar.alt: December 2026 calendar with the nineteenth marked as best day

people.brideAlt: Portrait of the bride Nguyen Le Thien Kim
people.groomAlt: Portrait of the groom Nguyen Dang Nguyen

invitation.title: INVITATION
invitation.intro: TOGETHER WITH OUR LOVED ONES, WE INVITE YOU TO JOIN US IN CELEBRATING OUR WEDDING DAY
invitation.note: Due to the venue's capacity limitations, we kindly invite only the children of our family and closest relatives to join us on this special day. We sincerely appreciate your understanding.
invitation.rsvpLine2: so we can finalize our guest count

timeline.title: TIMELINE
timeline.copy: Day filled with meaningful moments, from our first hello to the final dance. Come celebrate, laugh, and make memories along the way.

dresscode.title: DRESSCODE
dresscode.intro: We kindly ask you to dress formally to join us on this very special day.
dresscode.imageAlt: Illustration of guests wearing the suggested dress code colors
dresscode.noteLine1: We kindly ask our guests to
dresscode.noteStrong: leave white attire for the bride,
dresscode.noteLine2: and choose another color to celebrate with us. Thank you!

love.title: LOVE STORY
love.imageAlt: Illustration of a city bridge by the river
love.paragraph1: Some love stories begin with a grand moment.
love.paragraph2: For Nguyen (Andy) & Kim, theirs began rather quietly, with an Instagram connection, two students from Saigon who had both been accepted to Boston University.
love.paragraph3: What began as conversations about school slowly became walks through the cold Boston nights, shared meals, new cities, and a love that grew quietly with every season.
love.paragraph4: Through the years, they became each other's home, cheering one another on through dreams, challenges, and all the little moments in between.
love.paragraph5: After all these years, perhaps their greatest adventure is just beginning...

hero.title: An & Binh
hero.subtitle: On an October afternoon, we would love to gather the people we cherish and keep a gentle day in our hearts.
hero.imageAlt: Outdoor wedding table with cream flowers, wedding stationery, and rings

date.label: Wedding date
date.note: Family ceremony in the morning, intimate dinner in the evening.

time.label: Time
time.note: Guest welcome from 5:00 PM, ceremony begins on time.

venue.note: 12 Nguyen Van Huong, Thao Dien, Ho Chi Minh City.

date.title: Counting down to the day we begin forever.
date.copy: We cannot wait to see you for an evening of flowers, candles, music, and heartfelt wishes.

story.title: From summer coffee dates to an autumn promise.
story.copy: Some things arrive softly, then stay like the sweetest little habit.

firstMeeting.title: The day we met
firstMeeting.text: We met on a rainy Saigon afternoon. A short conversation about books, a cup of coffee still warm, and then journeys that lasted longer than either of us expected.

proposal.title: The promise
proposal.text: After many seasons together, we learned that peace can be as simple as having someone to tell every small story of the day.

promise.title: The wedding day
promise.text: Our celebration does not need to be loud. We only hope for a warm evening with family, friends, fresh flowers, music, and wishes from the heart.

schedule.title: A gentle evening, just enough to remember for a long time.

arrival.title: Guest welcome
arrival.text: Check in, take photos, and enjoy welcome drinks in the garden.

ceremony.title: Ceremony
ceremony.text: A quiet moment for vows, witnessed by our families and friends.

dinner.title: Dinner
dinner.text: A soft dinner, acoustic music, and celebratory wishes.

dance.title: Dance
dance.text: First dance, cake cutting, and the songs we both love.

album.title: Small details that make the day worth remembering.
album.copy: A few gentle glimpses of the wedding mood: flowers, rings, stationery, and the garden in late-afternoon light.
